title: CoverageAwareUtilityABR FoV-aware playback utility by FoV predictor
description: Matched 55, 74, 112, 150, 188, and 225 Mb/s fixed-rate study of FoV-aware delivered playback utility and outcomes for every FoV predictor. The CoverageAwareUtilityABR uses the full oracle bandwidth estimate (safety factor 1.0). FoV-aware playback utility v2 excludes the first two segments as predictor warm-up, prioritizes missing quality in the actual FoV over non-FoV quality waste, and includes persistent-FoV quality stability thereafter.
